title: V2pn partner pack (partner.json)
description: What a provider wants V2pn to look like for its subscriptions. Signed with the key its certificate names (partner.json.sig). V2pn ignores fields it does not know.

id.description: The partner id; must equal the certificate's.

name.description: The name people see. No control characters, and nothing that reads as V2pn.

logo.description: The wide logo for a dark title bar; a file in assets.

logoOnLight.description: The wide logo for a light title bar; a file in assets.

mark.description: A square mark on a transparent ground for the subscription card; a file in assets.

edition.description: Needs the certificate's edition grant; without it V2pn keeps its own look.

variants.description: The looks the pack offers, in the order the switcher lists them: neon (one column like a phone VPN app) and pass (plain V2pn with your card over the status card). Without variants, or with none V2pn knows, both: neon first when the pack has a theme, else pass. Older names are still read: signature and warm as pass; theme, cabinet, studio and ascii as neon.

default.description: The look that opens first; one of variants. Older names are read as in variants.

art.description: Pictures of Configra's former edition (lamp: the studio look). Read and checked as before; neither look draws them.

theme.description: Your theme for the two looks; needs the edition grant. Every field is optional. A field V2pn cannot use falls back to its default (tools/partner-check.cs says which and why); the looks always work. The layout, the font (Geist) and the corners are V2pn's. The fields of the former template themes (template, font, corners, density, blocks, art, palette.tone) are read without error, noted and not used; the theme builder drops them on save. Unknown fields are ignored.

brand.description: 1 to 3 brand colours. The first is the accent: Connect, Neon's glow, and the Pass card when the background is solid; the others colour the ring of Neon's round button. V2pn derives every other colour for light and dark, keeps text at 4.5:1 and controls at 3:1, darkens or lightens a brand colour where it becomes text, and turns one that could pass for a state colour (protected green, attention amber, unprotected red) away from it. Default: brand.accent.

background.description: The brand area of the Pass card. solid: the first brand colour. gradient: 2 to 4 colours corner to corner. image: a picture of the pack, 640-3200 px a side, at most 3:1, under a scrim V2pn works out so the text reads whatever the picture holds.

connect.description: Neon's connect control; what it does and the state colours are V2pn's. round: a big round button in a glowing ring of the brand colours. toggle: a row with the flag, the server and a switch. The older capsule and bar are read as round, with a note.

window.description: mini: Neon opens in the mini window (380x640) the first time; after that the window stays as the person leaves it. full: the window stays as it was.

api.description: The partner API's base address; needs the account grant and a domain the certificate names.

servers.description: Needs the certificate's actions grant. What V2pn shows about the servers of the partner's subscriptions: each entry matches a server by its exact name or its address. The API's GET servers may say the same with load and health; its values win.

name.description: The server's exact name (remark) in the subscription.

host.description: The server's address in the subscription.

group.description: A header in the list; the order of first mention is the order of the groups.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2; the flag and the map.

purpose.description: What the server is for; V2pn names it in the person's language. Unknown values are left out.

priority.description: Breaks a tie between equally good servers: higher first.

hidden.description: Not listed or offered; only the API's recommend can still pick it.

note.description: A short line under the server's name.

actions.description: Needs the certificate's actions grant. The partner's buttons: a label, one of V2pn's icons and one of V2pn's actions. V2pn shows the first 4 that it can run; an unknown do is left out.

strategy.description: connect.best: ping (lowest delay now), stable (most answers over V2pn's last 10 checks, then the lowest median, then the smallest spread), load (lowest load from GET servers; ping without one).

scope.description: connect.best: which servers it chooses from.

purpose.description: connect.recommend: asked as GET <api>recommend?purpose=. Needs the API.

group.description: connect.group: the fastest server of this group.

url.description: open.link: https on the certificate's domains or t.me, or tg:.

lock.description: Needs the certificate's lock grant: closes the settings of the partner's subscriptions, as the hide-settings header does. Without the grant it does nothing.

assets.description: Every file of the pack, pinned by size and SHA-256: at most 8 pictures, and routing.json, transport.json, core.json when the pack has them (used only when the certificate's reviewed field names the same hash; see $defs).

certReviewed.description: cert.json, written by V2pn's owner: "reviewed" maps each file read by hand to its SHA-256. A routing, transport or core grant counts only for the file with this hash.

routeEntryDomain.description: example.com or domain:example.com (the site and its subdomains), full:, keyword: (3+ characters), geosite:<tag>. No regular expressions.

routeEntryIp.description: An IP address, a network (91.108.4.0/22) or geoip:<tag>.

routingFile.title: routing.json (grant routing)
routingFile.description: A routing preset offered as a mode of "What goes through the VPN". The local network always goes direct first. A block rule may not block geoip: lists, a whole zone, a network wider than /16 or the local network. At most 2000 entries in all.

transportFile.title: transport.json (grant transport)
transportFile.description: Fragmentation and noise for the partner's own servers only, in place of the person's fragment setting for them. Xray takes both; sing-box only turns its TLS fragment on. mux is not taken.

packets.description: tlshello or a range of packets from 1 to 10.

noise.description: Xray only, on mKCP and Hysteria servers.

coreFile.title: core.json (grant core)
coreFile.description: A piece of Xray or sing-box config for the partner's own servers: extra outbounds (passing V2pn's subscription filter unchanged), a dialer for its servers, balancers (Xray) or urltest outbounds (sing-box), and rules to them. Tags are prefixed partner-<id>-; proxy is the partner's server the person connected to.

dialer.description: The tag of an outbound every server of the subscription is dialed through.

allowTop.description: sing-box only: top-level keys a whole-config subscription of the partner may keep.
